degree: Master of Science, Natural Language Processing
description: UC Santa Cruz's intensive master's in natural language processing, taught at its Silicon Valley campus and built around industry-sponsored capstones with real companies. Mine was No RAGrets, built with CarbonBridge. It pairs classic computational linguistics with modern deep learning, from statistical models to transformers, retrieval and agents. I studied under Ian Lane, Jeffrey Flanigan, Yi Zhang, Beth Ann Hockey, Amita Misra and Jalal Mahmud.
relevantCoursework: Deep Learning for Natural Language Processing
Data Science and Machine Learning Fundamentals
Advanced Machine Learning for Natural Language Processing
